total_model.summary: Model projects 42.9 total points (IND 26, TEN 17). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 3.7), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.8), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.5). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
